system.description:
The earth becomes as water to you: while melded within it you swim freely through the soil, an unseen predator moving beneath your enemies' feet.

This power is always automatically in effect while you are Earth Melded. You cannot see underground but gain a supernatural sense of your surroundings out to 50 yards, moving only through earth, sand or gravel — rock, cement, tree roots and water all block you. Underground, only direct physical contact is possible, and all combatants must bid an extra Physical Trait; a chase is won by the highest Physical Traits, or by the highest Celerity if any is present. You may also rise silently from the ground behind an unwary target to surprise them, though a target expecting such an attack may win a Mental Challenge against you to avoid being caught off guard.
